LayerNorm, stack of blocks, then dmodel → C
every point has two kinds of neighbour:
· the points beside it in the same period
· the same phase one period earlier
in 1D the second kind sits p steps away.
fold the line into a grid of width p and
both become immediate neighbours — so a
single 2D kernel reaches both at once.
what is learned, and what is not
the block computes 5 branches and keeps
1D is the wrong shape for periodic data. Fold it to 2D on the periods the FFT finds, and intraperiod and interperiod variation become two axes of one image —
which lets an off-the-shelf vision backbone do the temporal modelling. One design then covers forecasting, imputation, classification and anomaly detection.
